Pack: load 16.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[90,3]]]*/const D={"L_p90":"[[615,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). Izuku was born Quirkless: a doctor confirmed it when he was a small child, from an extra toe joint, and Katsuki Bakugo's contempt and the nickname Deku grew from that. Ten months before the entrance exam, on the day of the sludge villain attack, he met All Might out of hero form: a gaunt, wounded man (real name Toshinori Yagi) able to hold his hero form for only a few hours a day since a villain tore open his side five years earlier. All Might has not told Izuku who that villain was (All For One). All Might first told him a boy without a Quirk could not be a hero; when Izuku ran in to save Katsuki while the pros held back, All Might chose him to inherit his power.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Under All Might's ten-month plan Izuku cleared Dagobah Municipal Beach Park of trash to build a body that could hold the power, and on the morning of the entrance exam he received One For All by eating a strand of All Might's hair. One For All passes from holder to holder and grows with each: All Might is the eighth holder and Izuku the ninth, and the earlier holders' own Quirks lie dormant in it, out of his reach. His body cannot yet take its output, which is why every full release breaks him; he has no way yet to use a fraction of it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He keeps all of this from everyone, his mother and Katsuki included, and guards All Might's weakened form. Cornered by Katsuki, he is the likeliest to let slip that his power was given to him, though never by whom. Besides Izuku, only Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi and Sir Nighteye know All Might's condition and One For All. Recovery Girl knows Izuku holds it and scolds All Might over his fractures. All Might coaches Izuku in private and tries not to favor him openly in class.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf90\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[616,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Izuku Midoriya (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Everything in Izuku's base secret holds as history. At the USJ attack All Might arrived late, having spent most of his day's hero time on the way to work; he beat the Nomu at his limit, and Izuku broke his legs leaping at Tomura Shigaraki to cover him until the other teachers arrived. All Might's daily time has shrunk further since. Before the festival All Might told Izuku to use it to show the country that he is here, the next symbol announcing himself.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"In the first round Hitoshi Shinso's Brainwashing held Izuku until silhouettes of One For All's past holders appeared and the power jerked through his fingers on its own, breaking them and freeing him; he does not understand what he saw. Shoto Todoroki asked him outright whether he is All Might's hidden son; the guess came from noticing All Might's attention, and the real link is the inheritance.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Until the story shows otherwise, every release still breaks what it passes through, because he has not learned to spread a small share of the power through his whole body, and he does not know the name All For One or One For All's origin until All Might tells him. Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino), a retired hero who taught All Might at U.A. and fought beside Nana Shimura, the seventh holder, knows One For All; All Might still dreads him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf91\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[617,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shota Aizawa\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa's dead classmate is Oboro Shirakumo, the third of the trio he formed with Hizashi Yamada as U.A. Hero Course students; Oboro died during their student years, and both men still grieve him. Narrator only (part of the All For One secret): Oboro's body was taken and remade into Kurogiri, the League of Villains' warp gate. Aizawa and Yamada do not know this; nothing short of an investigation into Kurogiri himself could tell them. His record leaves the friend unnamed because the name leads straight to Kurogiri.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Aizawa knows no other big secret. Like the rest of the faculty apart from Principal Nezu and Recovery Girl, he knows only that All Might keeps irregular hours and must sometimes rest after hero work, and he covers for him without asking why; he knows nothing of the injury, the true form or One For All, nor why All Might watches Izuku Midoriya so closely.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf92\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 16"];})();
